description: Deterministic offline source-zero fallback used when /tmp/vision is unavailable.

files.content:
# North Star
Activity should compound into better agent behavior.

# Event
An event is an immutable record in the graph log.

# Evidence
Evidence retains provenance and replay metadata.

# Candidate
A candidate is a proposal awaiting governed promotion.

# Pipeline
Importer, normalizer, extractor, then promotion policy.

# Acquired Item
Format adapters emit stable source identity and replay metadata.

# Identity
The activity normalizer owns evidence identity and revisions.

# Inline Replay
Small ephemeral inputs may be retained inline.

# Artifact Replay
Persistent inputs use an immutable content-addressed artifact.

# Reference Only
Explicit policy may trade complete replay for reduced retention.

# Backfill
Historical ingestion is bounded and explicitly extendable.

# Cursors
Stable provider references are used instead of page offsets.

# Idempotency
Repeated snapshots and overlapping pages do not duplicate evidence.

# Revisions
Changed content supersedes an older revision without changing logical identity.

# Extractors
Extractor versions and configuration identities accompany candidates.

# Determinism
The zero-key floor uses deterministic structure and heuristics.

# Connection
Connection proves access but does not prove useful ingestion.

# Settlement
A named and versioned gate determines when a source counts.

# Volume Gate
Twenty-five unique evidence identities satisfy the default volume gate.

# Coverage Gate
Three provider-time coverage days satisfy the default span gate.

# Categories
Canonical source categories are closed and provider-neutral.

# Usage
The usage pack exposes neutral observational projections.

# Event Horizon
Derived state evaluates through one explicit canonical event horizon.

# Fixtures
Synthetic fixture evidence remains visible but never qualifies.

# Boundary
Packs expose facts while BabyAGI owns score, badges, and levels.

# Source Zero
The vision repository is the first local knowledge dogfood source.
